title: Creamy Mushroom Lasagna
description: A rich and savory Italian-inspired lasagna filled with sautéed mushrooms in a creamy bechamel sauce.
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
Sauté sliced mushrooms, chopped onion, and minced garlic in a pan until softened.
In a separate saucepan, heat the creamy bechamel sauce over low heat.
Combine sautéed mushrooms, Italian seasoning, and cooked lasagna noodles in a large mixing bowl.
In a 9x13-inch baking dish, create a thin layer of creamy bechamel sauce.
Layer cooked lasagna noodles, sautéed mushroom mixture, and shredded mozzarella cheese.
Repeat the layering process two more times, ending with a layer of mozzarella cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.
Let it rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese and serve hot.
